name: Seurat niches
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: Tissue niches from the cell types around each cell, imported from the authors' own Seurat package.
long_description: Runs the niche analysis of Seurat (Hao et al., Nat Biotechnol 2024) with the authors' published R package, imported as they ship it, with no method code of its own. It counts the cell types among each cell's nearest cells and groups cells with similar surroundings into niches with k-means. The niches are painted on the map, with their cell types and a downloadable list of every cell's niche.
citation: Hao Y, Stuart T, Kowalski MH, et al. Dictionary learning for integrative, multimodal and scalable single-cell analysis. Nat Biotechnol 42, 293-304 (2024).

params.name: field
params.label: Cell-type column (group.by)
params.help: The annotation counted around each cell: cell types, unless the dataset has none or you choose another column.

params.name: niches_k
params.label: Number of niches (niches.k)
params.help: How many niches k-means makes. The authors' Xenium analysis uses 5; the function's own default is 4.

params.name: neighbors_k
params.label: Spatial neighbours (neighbors.k)
params.help:
How many nearest cells make up a cell's surroundings. More neighbours give broader niches.
The authors' Xenium analysis uses 30; the function's own default is 20.

params.name: iter_max
params.label: K-means iterations (iter.max)
params.help:
The most iterations for each of k-means' 30 starts. 10 is what the authors' function uses.
Raise it when the summary says that starts stopped at this limit.
